text: No fire was detected on the asset during the evaluated period (2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24) based on NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly data. The analysis shows zero detections from MODIS and VIIRS sensors across the entire asset boundary for the covered days. However, data for the last day (2026-10-25) is missing due to a temporal gap in the near-real-time updates. While this suggests no major fires occurred, small, short-lived, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected. The evidence does not confirm the absence of burned areas either.
